messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the queue-gating safety-net tweak last night we're seeing a p95 latency bump and a ~12% throughput drop on the 8-GPU pools. dashboard shows spike at ~02:14 UTC. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
sam: Yep I noticed the alert. p50 is fine but p95 and p99 move up. Any recent kernel routing or token-budget changes?
lee: I rolled the gating change (reduced gate threshold to 0.65) in rollout-22. It was intended to avoid microburst queue overgrowth. deploy-bot: deploy/rollout-22 finished at 02:05 UTC by ci/cd (sha: a1b2c3).
maria: timeline matches. Quick peek at sample traces — a lot of requests get split into 2 small batches then hit the small-batch kernel which is much slower on these mid-length sequences (350-700 tokens).
anya: That smells like kernel mismatch + KV cache churn. If small-batch kernel has different memory layout it may be evicting prefix cache entries more often.
sam: Can you paste the profiler snippet? even short output helps.
maria: pasted a short dump from local perf: ```
2026-03-17T02:12:10 perf: batch_formation: mean_batch_size=2.1, median=2, tail=6
2026-03-17T02:12:10 perf: kernel_choice: small_batch_kernel=78%, large_batch_kernel=22%
2026-03-17T02:12:11 perf: kv_evictions/sec=45 -> baseline 8
2026-03-17T02:12:11 perf: p95_latency_ms=420 -> baseline 180
```
lee: whoa kv_evictions/sec x5. The safety-net lowered gate so more tiny batches go through; those tiny batches hit the small kernel which uses a slightly different KV cache access stride. That could cause mutex contention and evictions.
anya: I pulled a flamegraph for one of the slow tails — there are repeated KV lookup misses and a few lock waits in kv_store::get. linking artifact: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/abc123 (private)
sam: Nice catch. Two-prong mitigation: 1) increase gate threshold back to previous value (0.8) to let batches coalesce more, 2) short-term disable kernel affinity so routing picks large-batch path when possible. Can we test both in canary?
maria: I can revert threshold on a single pool and run the canary. Any objections?
lee: +1. Also propose adding a defensive limit: if kv_evictions/sec > 20 trigger temporary batching-backoff.
anya: Agree on the automatic backoff rule. Also adding a quick unit test to simulate rapid small-batch churn would help catch this next time.
sam: I'll open a follow-up perf ticket and assign actions. If canary shows improvement we roll rollback globally.
deploy-bot: deploy/rollout-22-revert started at 02:46 UTC by maria (canary pool: gpu-pool-8).
maria: Canary looks promising - p95 down to ~190ms and kv_evictions back to ~9/sec after revert. I'll continue monitoring for 30m then roll full revert. :thumbsup:
sam: Great. Capture the experiment configs and attach profiler traces to the ticket.
lee: Filing kernel-affinity follow-up to investigate stride/mutex in small-batch kernel.
anya: And I'll draft the unit test for kv churn.
maria: Thanks all — will update thread after full revert. :white_check_mark:
